outcome_policy: The user does not relay comment results. The nightly agent picks the outcome of the previous cliffhanger itself (prefer the more spectacular option), states it in a one-line recap at the start of the new episode, and makes sure both paths can converge. If the user writes 'ha vinto A/B' (or gives a commenter idea), that overrides the pick.

episodes.recap: Night janitor (the player) breaks into the City Museum to steal the Blue Star diamond ($40M, player's cut $4M) with crew Dex (hacker, cameras) and Vera (driver). Six minutes. Laser grid. At the dome a masked rival thief already holds the diamond and says the player's crew sold them both out. Alarm: guards in 30 s. Dex shouts it is a trap, Vera says she leaves in 30 s.
